info.name:
Lists every device discovered for the authenticated tenant, including every device column plus the
scanner version from its last scan run. Returns an empty array if the tenant has no discovered
devices yet — never a 404.

info.name:
Retrieves full detail for one device: every device column plus every agent found on it, each fully
expanded (tools, skills, business purpose, posture analysis run summary, and both risk-factor
collections — vulnerabilities and signals, never unioned, D35).
